description: Works out the late filing penalties on one monthly CIS return under Finance Act 2009 Schedule 55: £100 the day after the 19th, £200 at 2 months, then the greater of £300 and 5% of the deductions at 6 and at 12 months (5% alone for a first return). Takes the tax year and month, the filing date or none, today's date, the deductions and whether a return had been filed before. Returns each penalty with its date and whether it is charged, avoided or still to come. Does not cover deliberate withholding, interest on late payment, or appeals.

as_at.description: Today's date. Penalties on a return not yet filed run to this date, YYYY-MM-DD

deductions.description: The CIS deductions the return shows, or would show. Leave out or 0 for a nil return. Pounds, as a string like "1,200.00" or a number like 1200.

filed_before.description: true if the contractor had already filed a CIS return before this one was due (the usual case). false for the first return, which has no £300 minimum

filed_on.description: The day the return was filed. Leave out or null if it has not been filed, YYYY-MM-DD

tax_month.description: The tax month, 1 to 12: 1 is 6 April to 5 May, 12 is 6 March to 5 April

tax_year.description: The tax year, by the calendar year it starts in: 2026 for 6 April 2026 to 5 April 2027

name: cis_late_penalties
title: CIS late filing penalties
